task: Implement the Send Kudos wishes page (MoMorph screen JsTvi8KVQA, "Gửi lời chúc Kudos") at /kudos/send, persisting submissions to the local Supabase project.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /kudos/send renders the form when a real Supabase session is present (TC ID-0).
GET /kudos/send redirects an unauthenticated visitor to /login (TC ID-1).
Field order matches the frame: Người nhận, Danh hiệu, message editor, Hashtag, Image, anonymous checkbox, Nickname ẩn danh, footer (TC ID-3).
Recipient is an autocomplete over seeded profiles; placeholder "Tìm kiếm"; input is trimmed before filtering (TC ID-8, ID-10, ID-25, ID-26).
Gửi is disabled until Người nhận, Danh hiệu, message and >=1 hashtag are all filled (TC ID-48, ID-49).
Submitting with a required field empty shows a red border and "Không được để trống" and does not submit (TC ID-7, ID-11, ID-14, ID-50 … ID-56).
Hashtags are picked from the 8 seeded values by toggle, max 5, unselected rows disable at 5, chips removable (TC ID-15 … ID-17, ID-34 … ID-36).
Message editor: the 6 toolbar buttons wrap the selection in markdown; character counter enforces a hard 1000 cap.
Images: .jpg/.png accepted, .pdf/.mp4/.txt rejected with a format error, max 5, add button hides at 5 and returns on removal (TC ID-18 … ID-24, ID-37 … ID-40, ID-55).
Anonymous checkbox defaults unchecked; checking it reveals the required Nickname ẩn danh field, unchecking hides it (TC ID-6, ID-41 … ID-44).
Hủy discards everything and returns to /kudos without writing (TC ID-45).
A valid submit writes one row to the kudos table with sender from auth.uid(), uploads any images to Supabase Storage, then redirects to /kudos with a success toast (TC ID-46, ID-47).
RLS prevents a client from writing a kudos row attributed to another user.
